_comment: Hand-maintained overrides for scripts/ops/generate-stock-routes.mjs. `disabled` assets are excluded from config/loss-reward-stock-routes.json and the frontend candidate list even when the census would admit them; disable them on-chain with Deploy-LossRewardV2.ps1 -Step SetRouteEnabledBroadcast -Assets <symbols> -Enabled false (script/SetAssetEnabled.s.sol). Remove an entry (and re-enable on-chain) to bring an asset back.
